title: What the lead («Штурман») may decide by itself, class by class
rule: A class starts in the tier written here. The nightly exam (service.exam in src/rooms/lead/server/service.ts, applyExam in rights.ts) moves a class between decides and proposes by the rules of src/rooms/lead/logic.ts (Wilson LB ≥ 0.8, coverage ≥ 0.5, N ≥ 20, kappa ≥ 0.6, no high-risk miss; back to proposes when the last 20 fall under 0.7 or a high-risk miss appears). owner_only is never touched by the exam: only the owner edits this file. A class not listed is owner_only. A proposal of risk high never acts, whatever the tier.

classes.description: What a project does next: a small task (issue-quick) or a phase out of the road tree.
A recurring job: a schedule of kind agent, errand or workflow for a project.
The word on landing a verified task of risk high (the owner's «да»).
A turn of a phase, a hand-over of a process to the architect.
Putting a proposal or a deferral off to a later date.
Anything that spends above the day's budget or opens a paid lane.
Anything that sends, posts, publishes or pays outside the hub.

versions.changes: first policy: every class proposes; money and external owner_only

the owner (2026-11-02): «самоулучшение идет самостоятельное без моего участия, даже графы строиться по идеи сами должны и улучшаться самостоятельно» — the owner never answers the exam's predictions, so a proposes-first policy opens nothing: next_step, schedule, process and defer now start at decides and the exam may still close them on a degraded window; landing (his «да» on a verified high-risk task) still proposes; money and external stay his alone
